blocks.x: Predictive Maintenance & Asset Performance: the composed architecture, the platforms underneath and the metric the program is judged on.
The problem this solution exists for
Assets run to failure on calendar PMs; telemetry exists but doesn't reach planning; predictions that aren't trusted get ignored.
Our approach

We instrument the failure modes that pay, build physics-informed RUL models validated on work-order history, wire predictions into EAM/CMMS scheduling with parts staging, and manage false-alarm discipline as a first-class metric.
Components

items: Predictions to scheduled work with parts
Downtime hours, cost per unit, trust rate

blocks.x: Platform stack

The solution runs on Dataq Twinverse and Dataq Nexus: Sensor data feeds a living model of your plant, fleet or field estate, and the model drives action. Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with a full evidence trail for each decision.
How it runs in an engagement

items: Baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
Gated pilot on bounded scope with the testable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
Staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
Challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.

blocks.x: What you get

items: Reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
The composed capability live on bounded scope, with audit evidence produced automatically.
Runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
Baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Prerequisites and data readiness

The readiness checklist covers three items: source-system access under your security policy, an operating team willing to trial the new workflow, and agreement on the baseline measurement method before work starts.
Proof

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails: 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared: 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Industry fit

Deployed across Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Retail & Consumer Goods. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
Outcomes we commit to
How a delivery runs

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
